name: Heart of Xoroth allows Demon's Blood to stack 5 additional times (#1297)
contract: Heart of Xoroth 704956 reads 'Allows Demon's Blood to stack 5 additional times' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Its own baked effect is already the native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS), BasePoints 4 (+1 from DieSides 1 rounding = 5) - the same mechanism Necromancer's Capacity() (AscensionNecromancer.cpp) uses for spell 805011 - but its SpellClassMask ([536870912,0,16]) does not overlap Demon's Blood's (500906) actual family flags (dword1 bit4 / 16) in any of the three words. AscensionXorothContracts.cpp corrects the classmask to flag96(0, 16, 0); AscensionXoroth.cpp's Gain() replaces its hardcoded 6-stack cap with player->ApplySpellMod(500906, SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, cap) starting from a base of 6, so SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks (also read by the CoAGameplayTest set_aura fixture and the spell_max_stacks metric) reports 11 once the talent is known.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Demon's Blood's base cap is 6 stacks
SETUP: the base cap holds exactly 6 stacks
SETUP: Demon's Blood sits at the base cap
Force the Heart of Xoroth passive aura
SETUP: the Heart of Xoroth passive is active
CONTRACT: Demon's Blood's cap rises to 11 (6 base + 5 from the talent)
CONTRACT: the corrected cap accepts the full 11 stacks in practice
CONTRACT: Demon's Blood holds all 11 stacks
